operationName: Operation Swords of Iron (Israel) / October 7 War
heroHeadline: Israel Kills 4th Hamas Military Wing Chief as Tel al-Sultan Camp Strike Slaughters 45 on Eid al-Adha — Day 959
heroSubtitle: On Day 958 (May 26, 2026), Israel killed Mohammed Odeh — the fourth head of Hamas's Qassam Brigades since October 7 — in a strike on the Rimal neighborhood of Gaza City that also killed his wife and two children. A separate IDF strike on the Tel al-Sultan displacement camp in Rafah killed at least 45 people, and a border skirmish killed an Egyptian soldier — one of the most serious Israel-Egypt military incidents in decades. On Day 959 (May 27 / Eid al-Adha), Hamas and Israel both confirmed Odeh's death; he had been appointed just 11 days after predecessor Izz al-Din al-Haddad was killed on May 16. UN agencies report 470,000 Gazans now face catastrophic (IPC Phase 5) hunger through September 2026, with flour deliveries at 44% of required levels, the $4.1B Flash Appeal only 12% funded, and ceasefire Phase II talks completely deadlocked.
footerNote: Data sourced from IDF, Hamas, UN OCHA, UNRWA, WHO, ICJ, ICC, Times of Israel, Al Jazeera, Haaretz, IMEMC, WAFA, WFP, CBS News, Washington Post, Anadolu Agency, Pakistan Today. Day 958 (May 26 / Eid eve): Tel al-Sultan displacement camp bombed — 45+ killed Rafah; Odeh killed with family in Gaza City Rimal — 5 killed 12 wounded; Egyptian soldier killed at border skirmish. Day 956 (May 24): Abu Mlouh family killed incl. 1-yr-old Nuseirat; police station strike 7 dead. Day 955 (May 23): camp strikes; France bans Ben-Gvir. Day 954 (May 22): 422 flotilla activists arrive Turkey; Italy pushes EU sanctions. Day 948 (May 16): Haddad killed. Day 945 (May 13): Mohammed Sinwar killed. UNRWA staff killed: 391. IDF controls 64%+ Gaza (Orange Line).
